Name: Trash to Treasure
Author: TinyRATStudio
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Tired of fishing up soggy newspapers, broken glasses, and driftwood only to throw them away? This mod transforms ordinary trash items into genuinely useful and fun treasures!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI and enjoy



[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[/*]
[*]Useful & Fun Items: Trash items now provide special buffs, healing, or increased value.[/*]
[*]Plug & Play: Pure Content Patcher mod—easy to install and safe to remove anytime.[/*]
[*]Lightweight: No heavy scripts or extra frameworks required.



[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley (PC)[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher
